(5) The woman reaches into a high cabinet and retrieves a dark glass bottle with a purple lid. (6) In a close-up, several red, translucent fish-shaped capsules are poured into a palm from the dark bottle. (7) The boy smiles broadly and reaches with his hands towards the woman holding the supplement bottle in the kitchen. (8) The boy, wearing a red and blue Spider-Man hoodie, holds the bottle and points at it while smiling; red heart graphics appear around him. (9) A close-up of the 'Blackmores' bottle sitting on a grey stone outdoor surface under bright natural light. (11) The boy jumps and runs towards a front door decorated with a red scroll and hugs the woman tightly. (12) The woman stands in an outdoor parking lot under bright daylight, holding two bottles of fish oil; a large Costco building and white cars are visible behind her.
